clauses.source: Demo private car policy wording, Section I (illustrative)
clauses.text: Illustrative clause: The insurer may indemnify accidental loss of or damage to the insured vehicle, subject to the terms, conditions, limitations and exclusions of this policy.

clauses.source: Demo private car policy wording, Limitations as to Use (illustrative)
clauses.topics: permitted use private commercial food delivery
clauses.text: Illustrative clause: The vehicle may be used for social, domestic and pleasure purposes and for the insured's business. It must not be used for hire or reward, racing, speed testing, or a purpose not permitted by the policy schedule.

clauses.source: Demo private car policy wording, Exclusions (illustrative)
clauses.text: Illustrative clause: Loss or damage occurring while the vehicle is used outside the limitations as to use stated in the policy may be excluded, subject to the complete wording and applicable law.

clauses.source: Demo private car policy wording, Third-party section (illustrative)
clauses.text: Illustrative clause: The policy may cover the insured's legal liability for accidental death, bodily injury, or property damage to a third party, subject to policy terms and statutory requirements.

clauses.source: Demo private car policy wording, Theft section (illustrative)
clauses.text: Illustrative clause: Theft of the insured vehicle may be considered under the own-damage section, subject to prompt notice, police documentation, policy conditions and exclusions.

Illustrative procedure: Notify the insurer promptly, provide the policy number, date and circumstances of loss, registration details, and requested supporting documents. A survey may be arranged where required.
